announcements.title: Orbitwall v1.0 Released
announcements.description: Welcome to the all-new Nothing OS design system with Dot-Matrix typography, 4 live lock screen clock faces, and smooth wallpaper swiping.

announcements.title: Virtual Cloud Catalog
announcements.description: Wallpapers and full-resolution assets are streamed via ultra-fast edge CDN servers, keeping app size tiny and responsive.

announcements.title: Community & Support
announcements.description: Got suggestions or wallpaper requests? Reach out directly via Facebook or X (Twitter) using the developer links in Settings.
